action_items.title: Add an AGENTS.md with dev commands and conventions
action_items.why: Contributor instructions live off-repo (contributing.md is a 7-line link to tiangolo.com), so agents must reverse-engineer setup from CI YAML; the same gap fails single_command_setup and naming_consistency at Level 2
action_items.how: Commit AGENTS.md giving `uv sync` + `prek install` as the bootstrap, `bash scripts/test.sh`, `bash scripts/lint.sh`, `bash scripts/format.sh`, the 100% coverage rule, the docs_src/tests pairing and naming conventions

action_items.title: Add a pull request template
action_items.why: PRs need an emoji-prefixed title and a latest-changes label (a required check), but nothing tells an agent that before it opens one
action_items.how: Add .github/pull_request_template.md covering title format, label, regression test and docs_src example checklist

action_items.title: Add CODEOWNERS
action_items.why: No path ownership exists, so agents can't tell who reviews fastapi/ versus docs/<lang>/ translations
action_items.how: Add .github/CODEOWNERS mapping fastapi/ and tests/ to core maintainers and docs/<lang>/ to translation reviewers
